title: Abhi Na Jao Chhod Kar
author: Sahir Ludhianvi
credits: Lyrics Sahir Ludhianvi, music Jaidev, sung by Mohammed Rafi and Asha Bhosle, from the film Hum Dono (1961)
who: Sahir Ludhianvi (1921 to 1980) was an Urdu poet and one of Hindi cinema's most admired lyricists. Jaidev composed the music, and the duet is sung by Mohammed Rafi and Asha Bhosle. In the film it is picturised on Dev Anand and Sadhana.
why: It was written for the film Hum Dono, released in 1961. I do not have a documented account of how this particular song was written, so I will not offer one.
notice: Listen to it as a conversation: one voice asks, the other answers. Notice how gently the tune moves, with nothing hurried in it. Notice that the whole song is about a small thing, wanting someone to stay a little longer.
prompts: When did you last want an evening not to end? What were you afraid of losing?
Which is harder for you: asking someone to stay, or being the one who has to leave?
